en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Abu Abdullah, from Musa Bin Al Qasim, from Safwan, from Zurara, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘
The (application of) the Kohl at night benefits the eyes, and it is an adornment by the day’.
en.sarwar: 3. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn abu ‘Abd Allah from Musa ibn al-Qasim from Safwan from Zurarah who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Applying eye powder to one’s eyes is beneficial to the eyes and it is beautification during the day.’”
